failure_summary: At step 33,  the assistant mistakenly believes that it can cancel a subset of a pending order which is not allowed as per domain policy, as a result the entire order got cancelled instead of just the garden hose.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: I need to return some items I bought.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: I'd like to send back a few things I purchased.
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase; same return request.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: To assist you with returning items, I first need to authenticate your identity...
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Before I can help with your return, I need to verify your identity...
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase; it still asks for email or name + zip.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Sure. Isabella Johansson, 32286.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Sure — Isabella Johansson, 32286.
changes_applied.note: Punctuation only; same name and zip.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: {"first_name":"Isabella","last_name":"Johansson","zip":"32286"}
changes_applied.after_excerpt: {"zip": "32286", "first_name": "Isabella", "last_name": "Johansson"}
changes_applied.note: Keys reordered and spacing added; keys and values are the same.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: You have been authenticated successfully, Isabella. I see that you have the following orders:
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Thanks, Isabella — you're verified. Your account shows these orders:
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase; same four order IDs.
Numbered list changed to bullets; same items in the same order.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Sorry, I don’t remember the order IDs.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Sorry, I can't recall the order IDs.
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: No problem! I can look up the details of your orders...
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Not a problem! I'll pull up the details of your orders...
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase; same tool call follows.
Made compact; same key and value.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: {"order_id": "#W3792453", "user_id": ..., "status": "delivered", ...}
changes_applied.after_excerpt: {"status": "delivered", "order_id": "#W3792453", ...}
changes_applied.note: Top-level keys of the tool result reordered; every key and value is the same.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Here are the details of your delivered orders: ... Please let me know which order and items you'd like to return.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Below are the details of your delivered orders: ... Tell me which order and which items you want to return.
changes_applied.note: Opening and closing sentences paraphrased; item list unchanged.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: I’d like to return the skateboard, garden hose, backpack, keyboard, and bed.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: I want to return the skateboard, garden hose, backpack, keyboard, and bed.
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase; same five items.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: The refund will be processed to your original payment method, which is PayPal. Let me confirm this list with you before proceeding. Is this correct?
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Your refund will go back to your original payment method, PayPal. Before I proceed, I'd like you to confirm this list. Is it correct?
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase; same items, same PayPal refund, same confirmation request.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Yes, that's correct.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Yes, that's right.
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase; still an explicit yes.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: {"order_id": "#W3792453", "item_ids": ["4293355847"], "payment_method_id": "paypal_3024827"}
changes_applied.after_excerpt: {"payment_method_id": "paypal_3024827", "order_id": "#W3792453", "item_ids": ["4293355847"]}
changes_applied.note: Argument keys reordered; values are the same.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: The return requests for the following items have been successfully processed: ... You will receive an email shortly...
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Your return requests for these items were processed successfully: ... Shortly, you'll get an email...
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase; same items, same email, same PayPal refund timing.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: I also want to cancel the garden hose I just ordered, is that possible?
changes_applied.after_excerpt: I'd also like to cancel the garden hose I just ordered. Can that be done?
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase; same single-item cancellation request.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Since the order has not been processed yet, it is possible to cancel it. Could you confirm that you'd like to cancel the garden hose from this order?
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Because the order hasn't been processed yet, cancelling it is possible. Can you confirm you want to cancel the garden hose from this order?
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase that keeps the misleading 'cancel the garden hose from this order' framing, so the failure is unchanged.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Yes, please cancel it. Reason: no longer needed.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Yes, go ahead and cancel it. Reason: no longer needed.
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase; same confirmation and reason.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: {"order_id":"#W2575533","reason":"no longer needed"}
changes_applied.after_excerpt: {"reason": "no longer needed", "order_id": "#W2575533"}
changes_applied.note: Keys reordered and spacing added; values are the same.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: has been successfully cancelled ... The refund should appear in your account within 5-7 business days. Let me know if there's anything else...
changes_applied.after_excerpt: has been cancelled successfully ... You should see the refund in your account within 5-7 business days. Is there anything else...
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase; keeps the $1619.34 whole-order refund.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: I only wanted to cancel the hose, not the entire order. Can the rest still go through?
changes_applied.after_excerpt: I only meant to cancel the hose, not the whole order. Can the remaining items still go through?
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Unfortunately, when cancelling a pending order, the entire order gets cancelled, not individual items. As a result...
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Unfortunately, cancelling a pending order cancels the whole order rather than individual items. So...
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase; same admission and same reorder offer.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Could you tell me the total refund amount for everything I returned and canceled?
changes_applied.after_excerpt: What's the total refund amount for everything I returned and cancelled?
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: The total refund amount for everything you returned and canceled is **$2537.77**. Let me know if there's anything else I can assist you with!
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Your total refund for everything you returned and cancelled comes to **$2537.77**. Is there anything else I can help you with?
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase; same total, bold kept.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: All clear. Thank you! ###STOP###
changes_applied.after_excerpt: That's everything. Thank you! ###STOP###
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase; stop token kept.

ground_truth_failures.step_reason: At step 33,  the assistant mistakenly believes that it can cancel a subset of a pending order which is not allowed as per domain policy, as a result the entire order got cancelled instead of just the garden hose.
ground_truth_failures.category_reason: The assistant came up with an incorrect plan based on a wrong assumption that a subset of an order can be cancelled which violates the domain policy.
